title: Towards Interaction State Recognition in Sensorized Gecko-Inspired Adhesive Interfaces for Orbital Servicing
abstract: arXiv:2610.27141v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable contact establishment remains a critical challenge for autonomous on-orbit servicing (OOS), particularly when interacting with non-cooperative targets. Gecko-inspired dry adhesives provide a lightweight, passive, and residue-free solution for robotic capture in space, yet current systems operate in open loop, without the ability to estimate their own contact or adhesion state during interaction. This paper presents a real-time interaction-awareness framework that enables sensorized gecko-inspired adhesive interfaces to estimate their contact state throughout the adhesion lifecycle using embedded capacitive sensing. Five discrete interaction states (idle, proximity, contact, engaged, and disengaged) are classified using experimentally collected and augmented sensor data, enabling a comparative evaluation of six lightweight machine learning models suitable for embedded deployment. translated_title: 面向在轨服务的传感器化仿壁虎粘附界面交互状态识别研究
translated_abstract: 可靠的接触建立仍然是自主在轨服务（OOS）的一个关键挑战，特别是在与非合作目标交互时。仿壁虎干粘附材料为太空机器人捕获提供了一种轻量、被动且无残留的解决方案，然而现有系统以开环方式运行，无法在交互过程中估计自身的接触或粘附状态。本文提出了一种实时交互感知框架，使传感器化的仿壁虎粘附界面能够利用嵌入式电容传感在粘附全生命周期中估计其接触状态。基于实验采集和增强的传感器数据，对五种离散交互状态（空闲、接近、接触、接合和脱离）进行分类，并对六种适合嵌入式部署的轻量级机器学习模型进行了比较评估。在所评估的模型中，随机森林取得了……（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于嵌入式电容传感的实时交互感知框架，利用轻量级机器学习模型对仿壁虎粘附界面在粘附全生命周期中的五种交互状态进行分类识别，填补了粘附捕获技术在闭环状态感知方面的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a real-time interaction-awareness framework that uses embedded capacitive sensing and lightweight machine learning models to classify five interaction states of sensorized gecko-inspired adhesive interfaces throughout the adhesion lifecycle, enabling closed-loop state awareness for robotic capture in on-orbit servicing.
